scope: CORRECTION from the binary: the positive-width codec is a gate bit followed by N plain LSB-first bits
source: 0x670B15 (the default branch of the field codec decoder 0x6701D0)
disassembly_gist: 0x670B1E jne 0x670B37 -> if bit == 1 read the value
0x670B20 mov [ebx],0 -> if bit == 0 the value is 0 and the field ends
0x670B3A mov eax,[eax+4] -> N = the field width
what_was_wrong: round 116 imported the 3.3.3.3 rule 'gate bit, then width%%8 remainder bits FIRST, then whole bytes' and applied it to this build
this build does NOT do that: it reads the plain N-bit LSB field
that mistake made every non-zero value we wrote have the wrong bit order, which is consistent with all non-zero attempts being rejected or crashing

code_fix.change: positive codec writes/reads gate bit + N plain LSB bits

docs: docs/SNAPSHOT-FORMAT.md section 11 records the correction and supersedes section 10.2
next: re-run the index-22 value test with the corrected encoder: value 0x100 should cost 40 ps bits (29 - 1 + 12) and, if the bit order was the only problem, the snapshot should be accepted
